title: Detecting LGBTQ+ Instances of Cyberbullying

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pre-trained language models (RoBERTa, BERT, GPT-2) on an annotated dataset of Instagram comments to detect LGBTQ+-targeted cyberbullying, including an analysis of false negatives and the models' ability to recognize implicit or coded homophobic language.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
